items.text: I can explain what path-based routing is and why it matters for microservices
I understand what a Listener, Listener Rule, and Target Group are and how they relate
I can describe how ALB health checks work and what happens when all targets fail
I can explain the three ASG capacity settings: minimum, desired, and maximum
I understand the difference between ALB (Layer 7) and NLB (Layer 4) and their use cases
I can explain why NLB → ALB chaining is valid but ALB → NLB is not supported
I can create an ALB with path-based routing rules for a microservices architecture
I can create and configure Target Groups with appropriate health check settings
I can create a Launch Template with user data for automatic EC2 initialization
I can create an Auto Scaling Group and attach it to an ALB target group
I can configure a Target Tracking scaling policy based on CPU utilization
I can verify path-based routing is working correctly using the ALB DNS name
I know ALB = Layer 7 and NLB = Layer 4 of the OSI model
I know NLB supports Elastic IP (static IP); ALB uses DNS with dynamic IPs
I know the default ASG termination policy terminates the oldest launch configuration first
I know a 503 error is returned when all targets in a target group are unhealthy
